# Agent instructions

- Read and follow the Codex autoformalize skill at `.codex/skills/autoformalize/SKILL.md` when present,
  otherwise the user-installed copy at `~/.codex/skills/autoformalize/SKILL.md`
  (or `$CODEX_HOME/skills/autoformalize/SKILL.md` when `CODEX_HOME` is configured).
- Then read the applicable instructions in `automation/`, beginning with `automation/instructions.md`,
  followed by `automation/Status.md` and `automation/ErrorReport.md`.
- The local instructions in `automation/` supersede conflicting guidance in the skill.
  The user's current explicit instructions take precedence over both.
